1.1: and youngest in my father’s house. I tended my father’s sheep.
1.2: and my fingers tuned a lyre.
1.3: The Lord himself, he himself hears.
1.4: and he anointed me with his anointing oil.
1.5: but the Lord didn’t take pleasure in them.
1.6: and he cursed me by his idols.
1.7: and removed reproach from the children of Israel.
